# TestScript for 24-flat-completion-flag
# Asserts adaptive shell completion defaults for flat CLIs:
# 1. By default, flat CLIs use the --completion flag (Task / ripgrep style).
# 2. No Commands: section is generated in the --help output.

# 1. Default flat CLI: --help displays the --completion flag with no Commands: section
exec minify --help
stdout 'Usage:\n  minify <input> \[flags\.\.\.\]'
stdout 'Flags:'
stdout '--completion=SHELL\s+Generate shell completion script'
! stdout 'Commands:'

# 2. Default flat CLI: --completion generates completion scripts for supported shells
exec minify --completion bash
stdout '_minify_completion'
stdout 'complete -o noquote -F _minify_completion minify'

exec minify --completion zsh
stdout '#compdef minify'
stdout '_minify_completion'

# 3. Default flat CLI: unknown shell returns exit code 2 (usage error)
exit-status 2 minify --completion invalidshell
stderr 'unknown shell "invalidshell"'

# 4. Default flat CLI: normal command execution
exec minify -l 9 bundle.js
stdout '-l, --level\s+int\s+9\s+● cli --level'
stdout 'Minifying bundle.js \(level=9, output=<stdout>\)'
